_sources: FP = docs/research/frostpunk-balance.md (Frostpunk 1, Normal); RW = docs/research/rimworld-body.md (RimWorld 1.5); OURS = glue neither game provides — mark and revisit in playtest, do not hand-tune.

scale._note: FP starts with 80 people, we start with 10: k = 10/80. Per-person rates are unchanged; totals (fuel, start stock, pile sizes) scale by k.

time._src: FP 4.2 shifts 08-18, hunters 18-06; FP 3.1 weather changes at 07:00; FP 4.4 sickness settles ~00-04 (we roll at 02:00)

map._src: FP 8: 4-5 coal piles, 3-4 wood crates, steel wreckage. Forest tile amount is OURS (FP: sawmills clear trees and relocate).

heat._src: FP 1.1: level = (T+20)/10 + insulation + zone + heater. fire_spot_bonus OURS: FP says sleeping by the generator's red zone does not make people sick.

furnace._src: FP 2.1: 6 coal/h per power level (scaled by k), +1 heat level per power level inside the zone, range upgrade +2 tiles. Base radius and relight_minutes OURS (FP base radius unknown).

overdrive._src: FP Generator wiki (docs/research/frostpunk-balance.md 2.3): overdrive +1 heat level in the zone (+2 with Overdrive Couplings), no extra coal, pressure +4%/h while on, -2%/h while off; first time at 100% an event asks to sacrifice a steam core or a child and pressure drops to ~75% (Generator page; A New Home page says 65%, we use the Generator page); second time the generator explodes. OURS: an exploded furnace stays unlit for good (FP: game over).

heater._src: FP 1.4: heater +1 level per tier, 1 coal/h per tier per building. Our buildings are 0.4 of an FP building (job tiers 2/4/6 vs 5/10/15), so burn x0.4. Max tier 3; the tech tree gates tiers 1/2/3.

weather._src: Owner 2026-10-27: hook early, big test late. Standard = FP main scenario pacing; harsh/hardcore = FP Endurance.
weather._mode: Owner 2026-11-01: 'chaotic' (the game) = no forecast; storms land at Lorenz-63 z peaks and show themselves only through noisy precursors (see weather.chaos and sim/weather.gd). 'scripted' = FP fixed days + forecast_days warning, kept for old saves, replays and RL traces/regression (RL resets pass it explicitly).

chaos._src: Lorenz-63 classic parameters (sigma 10, rho 28, beta 8/3; Lorenz 1963), integer fixed point. Storm temperatures, durations, A New Home's great-storm shape (5 days, -150 last night, scenario win) and the recurring FP list stay the FP numbers in weather_profiles. OURS (owner 2026-11-01: one weather for game and research, docs/ml/DIFFUSION-PROPOSAL.md, docs/ml/DIFFUSION-RESEARCH.md): time scale 5 Euler steps of dt 1/256 per game hour, spin-up 7200 steps; a storm lands at an hourly local z peak: recurring storms above peak_c/100 from first_day and >= min_gap_days after the last storm ended; a scenario storm (A New Home) at the first peak above scenario.peak_c/100 from scenario.open_day, or the first peak of any height from scenario.force_day; tier thresholds (1/100 z); precursors are noisy readings of the current state only (pressure from z, wind from |y| and the (x,y) sector, daily animals/sky from the 24 h max z); noise levels murky (default, +-4 hPa, wind +-3) / clear (+-1 hPa, wind +-1, experiments); bot warning rule; HUD trend arrows; oracle horizon.

a_new_home._status: PROVISIONAL: only the FP nodes known so far (doc 3.2); full day-by-day table being researched (docs/research/frostpunk-weather.md).

storms._src: FP A New Home Normal, Steam guide 3343113747: FP D42 -90, D43 -90, D44 -110, D45 -110, D46 -120, D47 02:00 -150, ~07:45 storm ends at -30 and the scenario is won (our day = FP day - 1). final_phase: the night after the last storm day, from start_h to end_h.

after._status: OURS placeholder for the persistent game after the scenario's storm (FP scenario ends there).

a_new_home._src: FP A New Home Normal (docs/research/frostpunk-weather.md): D4 cold snap (-40: dev diary/namu/wiki majority over one guide's -30), D6 thaw, D10 -40, D12 -30, D15 -40, D18 -60, D19 -70, D21 -60, D24 -70 (one source, v1.0). Storm D42-47 from the 2024 Steam Normal log. OURS: D25-D41 holds -70 with one -80 day before the storm (no source has these days);

endurance._src: FP 3.2 Endurance: -20, D4 -40, D6 -30, D8 -40, D10 -50, D12 -40; storms from day 14, 2 days, -70 then -80, interval shrinks by 2 to 8. Random walk, first interval and -90 cap are OURS.

body._src_body: FP 1.2 personal temperature drifts toward the place's heat level.
body._src_sick: FP 1.1: comfortable 0, livable 3%, chilly 15% (rolled nightly). Cold/very cold/freezing values are OURS (extrapolated, per FP doc 11.5).
body._src_approach: OURS: FP says chance rises/falls slowly; slope unknown.
body._src_stage: FP 4.5 Normal: sick -> gravely ill -> death, 3 days per stage untreated; FP 1.1 very cold ~25% gravely ill.
body._src_hypo: RW 9.1 hypothermia rates and recovery. hypo_safe_c is OURS glue (FP people work outdoors at -40, so RW's safe line maps to the bottom of FP 'very cold').
body._src_warm: RW 9.2 stages. Walking to the fire at 'mild' is OURS (the ad behaviour).
body._src_digits: RW body def Human: 10 fingers + 10 toes (ears/nose not modeled). Fingers count for Manipulation -> work loss on fingers only; RW toes feed Moving but no clean per-toe number, so toes have no effect (OURS). Rolls stop once all 20 are lost.
body._src_frost: RW 9.3 (simplified): above 37% severity, 35%/h; two frostbites on one part = lost; lost digit -5% work (RW E).

food._src: FP 4.3: 1 ration/person/day, starving eat 2, 3 days per hunger stage (full->hungry->starving->dead), raw food 1:1 and riskier. Raw sickness 5% is RW E.

laws._src: FP 4.2/4.3/7.1/7.2. Recipes, extended-shift hours and +2.5 discontent are FP numbers; hope/discontent sizes use FP's icon tiers x 3 points per tier (OURS conversion, FP gives tiers not percentages).

soup.name: 稀汤
soup.text: 把生食熬成稀汤，同样的食物能多喂几张嘴，但没人喜欢喝。

food_additives.name: 掺料口粮
food_additives.text: 往口粮里掺锯末，分量更多，但吃了可能会病。
food_additives._src_sick: FP 3.5% easy .. 6.5% extreme; 5% is OURS midpoint

child_labour_safe.name: 童工（安全岗位）
child_labour_safe.text: 让孩子去厨房和资源堆帮忙。
child_labour_safe._src: FP Child Labour - Safe Jobs: cookhouse, gathering posts, resource piles. FP lists no icon tier for Safe Jobs; -1 hope is OURS.

extended_shift.name: 延长班次
extended_shift.text: 允许指定的岗位从 6 点干到 20 点，产量约 +40%，每个延长班岗位每天都会让人不满。

mood._status: OURS, PENDING (except needs_discontent_tiers): start values, death sizes, storm forecast and daily drifts; FP gives directions but no magnitudes (FP 7.3). Revisit with RW mood mapping.
mood._src_needs: FP Citizen Needs modifier, tier size from Overcrowding (frostpunk-balance.md 7.1/7.2; wiki Discontent: Lack of shelter, People are hungry, Cold at home, Generator is not working). Each condition present adds a fixed +1 tier (x points_per_tier) to discontent while it holds and is removed the moment it clears; not per person, not cumulative. Re-evaluated once a day.
mood._src_breaks: RW MentalBreaker (rimworld-body.md 7.3): break thresholds 35/20/5 % mood, mean time between breaks 4/0.8/0.5 days; durations from RW examples: sad wander 16-24 h (minor), dazed 28-36 h (major), catatonic 40 h-5 d (extreme); catharsis after a break +40 mood for 3 days -> no new break for 3 days. V': camp hope stands in for each person's mood (FP has one camp value), rolled once a day with p = 1 - exp(-1/MTB); a person on a break does not work.

ultimatum._src: FP Hope/Discontent wiki (frostpunk-balance.md 7.3): discontent at max or hope at min triggers an ultimatum; the player has 'a few days' to turn it round, otherwise exile = game over; success gives a hope bonus. OURS: 3 days, 'turned round' = out of the top/bottom fifth of the bar, bonus = 1 FP icon tier. Gentle has no ultimatum; offline the deadline waits.

events._src: FP A New Home 'Refugees from Frostland' (docs/research/frostpunk-refugees.md): no random arrivals in FP; wave 1 on day 31 (ru wiki), accept all 70 (30 sick) / healthy 40 x k, random rounding. Waves 2-3 sizes, sick share and the 1-day spacing are OURS (wiki gives no numbers). Role split = FP start ratio 50:15:15. Hope/discontent sizes OURS.

start._src: FP 8 Normal: 80 people (50/15/15), 0 coal, 30 wood, 10 steel, 100 raw food — times k; 1 steam core (discrete, not scaled). parts = FP steel.

gear._src: RW 1.5 (docs/research/gear-mood-life.md 1.1-1.5, rimworld-body.md 1.1-1.3): 7 quality tiers; Insulation_Cold quality mult 0.8..1.8 (Stats_Apparel InsulationBase); cloth parka 2.0 x 18 = 36 C, cloth tuque 0.5 x 18 = 9 C; clothing lowers the safe/comfortable temperature by its insulation (PawnStats ComfyTemperatureMin GearStatOffset). Tools: RW tool cabinet +6% work speed (Buildings_Misc) scaled by the melee-damage quality curve 0.8..1.65 (V' per gear-mood-life 5.1: RW tools have no quality). Loot quality: RW QualityUtility BaseGen distribution for ordinary sites, Reward distribution for risky sites; Darkest Dungeon trinkets: longer expeditions raise the quality floor one tier. OURS: one item per site visit, the three kinds equally likely, long = site min hours >= 14, durability/wear not modelled.

life._src: RW 1.5 + Biotech (docs/research/gear-mood-life.md 4.x). 1 year = 60 days; ageing x1 adults, x4 children up to 11 then linear to x1 at 20 (Difficulty.cs, Pawn_AgeTracker); adult at 18 (LifeStages); heart attack yearly chance by age 64 2.4 % ... 80+ 18.1 %, from 0 at age 48 (RW MTB curve 0.6 -> never), untreated 77 % fatal; romance from 16; pregnancy 5 % per night x female x male fertility curves; gestation 18 days; birth healthy 90 % / sick 7.5 % / stillborn 2.5 %; mother death by birth quality (0 -> 20 %, 0.2 -> 5 %, 0.9 -> 0), quality 0.5 base (mother 20-30) + 0.05 indoors + 0.05 bed; healthy baby +8 mood (V': camp hope); pregnancy work -5 %/-10 % in 2nd/3rd trimester (Manipulation); child work ages 3 hauling (resource piles), 7 cooking/gathering. OURS: partners pair automatically (nearest age, unpartnered man/woman 16+), gender from the fixed name list, birthday spread by id, babies eat a full ration, FP children work at full speed (RW age speed curve not applied).

offline._src: GDD 7: offline the camp runs at the season pace, capped, nobody dies, choices queue. Cap 12 real hours = AFK Arena's idle-reward cap (common idle-game practice; OURS choice of reference). Overdrive is switched off while away (OURS safety plan: an explosion would end the camp).
offline._src_pace: owner decision 2026-10-29: season ~ 3 real days (GDD 3): 60 game days / 3 real days = 20 game days per real day (1/3 game minute per real second); replaces the earlier 1/4-of-online rule.
